snippet.title: Once A Pawn A King | 1.0 Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Once a Pawn a King 1.0  is Out Now on Steam!
Play now ➤https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298910/Once_a_Pawn_a_King/

Fight through a shattered kingdom in this chess-inspired roguelike where every piece matters. Build your army, discover powerful upgrades, and turn humble pawns into legendary champions as you battle to rescue the Black King.

One wrong move could cost the kingdom. One great move could save it.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
